description: Create a read-only public link to the latest result for one of your monitors. The link contains monitor metadata and evidence, never the API key, and expires automatically. Use it to share a verified change with a teammate, customer, or agent. Requires a free watch key or paid API key.

expires_in_days.description: Link lifetime in days, up to 30 days.

monitor_id.description: The monitor ID whose latest evidence should be shared.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for the shared report.

name: create_share_link
title: Create Shareable Evidence Link
